notes: Wisp: living current, a FLOATING rig (kind "floating": 49x49, pivot (24,24)). No walk: the legs layer is the trailing glow tail, drawn pointing back (down at rotation 0) and turned to the movement direction: two helix strands of light that narrow to a flicker and run to the frame edge. Its `float` animation (6 frames, 8 fps, a closed loop) plays by time; `stand` is the idle frame. The body (torso, head, arms) sits in the middle of the frame as a normal body and the drawer bobs it, so no bob is baked in. A body of braided ribbons round a bright core, ribbon arms ending in spark knots, an orb head with two dark eye marks (head variants: orb, forked = lightning tendrils over the shoulders). The mounts are the human's moved by (+8,+8). torso_glow (2 flicker frames at ~4 fps), head_glow and legs_glow (one frame per legs frame) are strong: the Wisp is mostly light. Outfit mask = the scrap-cloth scarf (chest band and streamer). Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 49x49 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0-5 are the float cycle (a closed loop played by time, whether or not they move), frame 6 the idle: this layer is what trails behind the body (drawn pointing back, turned to the movement direction)

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. RIG KIND floating: this frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24), so every mount here is the shared one moved by (+8,+8): mount - pivot is identical to the human rig.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 4 fps
